dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped rings are visible on the mid-dorsal flank, characterized by sharp gradient transitions from a dark charcoal exterior to a light-grey perimeter with a dark focal center. The geometries are predominantly elliptical with clearly defined, continuous perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated along the lower lateral margin and cervical region. These clusters are asymmetrical and lack an internal gradient or dark core, appearing as localized, solid-colored speckles.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form a scalene triangle with the apex oriented toward the dorsal peak. A secondary sequence of high-intensity blobs near the anterior flipper forms a roughly linear arrangement of three distinct points.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense, reticulated web-like pattern of high-contrast pixels covers the cranial and neck regions, where individual rings merge into an interconnected mottled texture.
